results.title: Station Casinos
results.snippet: The company started out as a locals casino operator on July 1, 1976, opening the Bingo Palace. This establishment was later renamed Palace Station.

results.title: Station Casinos
results.snippet: Red Rock Resorts, Inc. is a publicly traded holding company that owns a portion of Station Casinos. The company operates the Wildfire brand of smaller neighborhood casinos without hotel rooms.

results.title: Red Rock Casino, Resort & Spa
results.snippet: Red Rock Casino Resort & Spa is Station Casinos' flagship property, and the company's corporate headquarters is located on the property.

results.snippet: The company has also branched out into managing casinos that they do not own.
